scope: Focused acceptance for opt-in share progress, deduplicated watch history and automatic revocation.

coverage: Default-off links retain ordinary expiry and produce no share history or presence.
Idle cleanup protects a connected viewer and does not close an unused link.
Browser watch coverage skips seek gaps and concurrent completions create one history entry.
VRChat byte-range probes and repeat segment requests add no extra coverage. Distinct viewer grants cannot combine coverage for a watch.

hosted.data: Generated H.264 and AAC fixture in a disposable Jellyfin library and PostgreSQL database
hosted.transport: Production share creation, capability rewrite, HLS relay, tracking and encoder stop with a VRChat-style HTTP client
checks: A HEAD probe creates no viewer grant.
A decoded segment increments coverage once even if requested again.
The live activity exposes estimated VRChat progress.
Revocation stops the encoder, clears live activity and invalidates the existing resource URL.

remaining: This run exercised the VRChat protocol through HTTP and FFmpeg. Physical VRChat players, long-session playback and joined party behavior remain outside its scope.
